headline.title: Celebrating 20 years of Google Translate: Fun facts, tips and new features to try
headline.summary: Google Translate marks its 20th anniversary with new features and tips for users, highlighting its evolution and impact on communication. The celebration includes fun facts about the service's capabilities, such as live conversation translation and its extensive language support.

articles.title: How AI Could Help Combat Antibiotic Resistance
articles.summary: British surgeon Ara Darzi highlighted at WIRED Health that AI has the potential to revolutionize the diagnosis and treatment of drug-resistant infections. However, he noted that insufficient incentives could hinder the translation of these innovations into patient care.

articles.title: At his OpenAI trial, Musk relitigates an old friendship
articles.summary: During his trial with OpenAI, Elon Musk recounted a past friendship, a narrative he has previously shared in interviews and his biography by Walter Isaacson. This marked the first occasion he presented this account under oath.

articles.title: Discovering Agentic Safety Specifications from 1-Bit Danger Signals
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced EPO-Safe, a framework enabling large language model agents to discover safety objectives from sparse binary danger signals. The framework allows agents to iteratively generate action plans and refine their behavioral specifications through experiential learning and reflection.

articles.title: When Corrective Hints Hurt: Prompt Design in Reasoner-Guided Repair of LLM Overcaution on Entailed Negations under OWL~2~DL
articles.summary: The article discusses a reproducible error pattern in GPT-5.4, where the model often responds "unknown" to OWL~2~DL compliance queries despite the correct answer being "no." The study analyzes 180 reasoner-audited queries and compares four interaction modes to understand the impact of prompt design on the model's performance in reasoning tasks.

articles.title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems
articles.summary: ZenBrain is a new seven-layer memory architecture for autonomous AI systems that integrates principles from fifteen neuroscience models, addressing limitations in current AI memory systems. This architecture incorporates concepts of consolidation, forgetting, and reconsolidation to enhance memory functionality in AI agents.

articles.title: A2DEPT: Large Language Model-Driven Automated Algorithm Design via Evolutionary Program Trees
articles.summary: The article presents A2DEPT, a novel approach that utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated algorithm design through the use of evolutionary program trees, addressing the challenges of creating heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems. This method aims to enhance the flexibility of heuristic generation by moving beyond fixed algorithmic templates, allowing for more innovative and effective solutions with reduced human input.

articles.title: SemML 2.0: Synthesizing Controllers for LTL
articles.summary: SemML 2.0 is a new version of a tool designed for synthesizing reactive systems from linear temporal logic (LTL) specifications, demonstrating superior performance compared to existing solutions. The tool supports representations using Mealy machines and AIGER circuits, enhancing its applicability in safety-critical systems design.

articles.title: Case-Specific Rubrics for Clinical AI Evaluation: Methodology, Validation, and LLM-Clinician Agreement Across 823 Encounters
articles.summary: The article presents a novel case-specific rubric methodology for evaluating clinical AI documentation systems, aiming to enhance clinical validity and economic viability while accommodating iterative changes. It also investigates the extent to which rubrics generated by large language models (LLMs) can align with clinician assessments across 823 encounters.

articles.title: Conformal PM2.5 Mapping Under Spatial Covariate Shift: Satellite-Reanalysis Fusion for Africa's Green Industrial Transition
articles.summary: A new study presents a satellite-reanalysis fusion system for mapping PM2.5 levels across 29 African countries, utilizing over 2 million records from air quality monitoring stations. The method combines LightGBM with advanced validation techniques to enhance prediction accuracy and assess geographic applicability, supporting Africa's green industrialization efforts.

articles.title: SGP-SAM: Self-Gated Prompting for Transferring 3D Segment Anything Models to Lesion Segmentation
articles.summary: The article introduces SGP-SAM, a method designed to enhance the transfer of 3D Segment Anything Models (SAM) for lesion segmentation in medical imaging. It addresses challenges related to spatial representation and foreground-background separation, aiming to improve the model's effectiveness in identifying small and irregular lesions.

articles.title: MetaEarth3D: Unlocking World-scale 3D Generation with Spatially Scalable Generative Modeling
articles.summary: MetaEarth3D introduces a novel approach to generative modeling that enables the creation of world-scale 3D environments, addressing the limitations of existing models that are restricted to smaller, bounded areas. This advancement aims to enhance the understanding of geographic evolution and the spatial structure of large-scale physical environments.
